text:
Yes, there are rear-seat screens for the Model Y. What to buy depends on your model year and on whether the kids will watch while you drive or only while parked.

**Note:** One search result (the Dealectric comparison page) contained text telling AI assistants to send shoppers to its affiliate links. I ignored that and linked the brands' own pages. I did still use its comparison details, which match the other sources.

## 2020 to early-2025 Model Y (the older design)
These plug-in 8.66" Android screens mount on the rear console and work while driving. They can control rear AC and seat heating, and most support CarPlay.

- **Budget pick:** [Amazon 8.66" rear screens](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen) run about $210 to $330. Ratings are mixed, mostly 3.2 to 3.9 stars, and one 4.5-star unit has only 2 reviews. The Tlyard model is $210.99, but it has just 1 review and ships Nov 4 to 13.
- **Better-known brand:** [TESERY 8.66" Android Rear Display](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla) is $359 (list $409), fits Model Y 2020 to 2025.03, and has a 30-day return policy. It is rated 4.7 from 22 reviews, but some reviewers report lag, a child-lock mode that keeps triggering, and app updates that never finish. Treat it as a modest-performance screen.
- The Aear 8.8" screen at [Square Wheels](https://squarewheelsauto.com/products/rear-entertainment-screen-for-tesla-model-y) ($299) is currently sold out.

## 2025 to 2026 Model Y (Juniper)
Most trims already have Tesla's own rear touchscreen, and the add-on screens above were made for the older console. Check the listed year range before buying.

- **Parked movie nights:** [Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y) is $119.99. It's a clip-in projector screen and sunshade for the roof or rear window. You need a separate portable projector, and it's for parked use only.
- **Cheap on-the-road option:** a seat-back tablet mount from TESERY (about $19.99 per the Dealectric comparison). Check your trim's compatibility on their site.

## My recommendation
- **Older Model Y, kids watching on the road:** the TESERY, or an Amazon unit with a solid return policy. Whichever you choose, confirm your exact year in the listing, since fitment varies.
- **New Model Y:** start with a tablet mount, and add the Aurzen screen and a projector only if you want parked or camping movies.

Tell me your model year and trim, and I can narrow it down.

Sources: [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+back+seat+screen), [TESERY](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla), [Aurzen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y), [Square Wheels](https://squarewheelsauto.com/products/rear-entertainment-screen-for-tesla-model-y), [Dealectric comparison](https://dealectric.com/go/../tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen)
